hypothesis: Crypto performs best when macro risk appetite and crypto liquidity expansion align.
economic_rationale: Risk appetite lowers discount rates for speculative assets; stablecoin/TVL expansion proxies available crypto liquidity.
required_features: vix_level, vix_change_21d, equity_momentum_21d, equity_realized_vol_21d, stablecoin_supply_change_7d, tvl_growth_30d, top_universe_above_30dma_pct
data_availability: available from existing macro/public crypto files
exact_formula_or_model_specification: Score = macro votes + liquidity/breadth votes; BTC/ETH/cash allocation by score.
risk_controls: cash when score is weak; no leverage; turnover cap inherited from frozen framework
expected_failure_mode: Fails if liquidity proxies are stale or macro risk appetite is already priced.
reason_not_full_feature_ml: Uses seven economically filtered features, not all accepted features.
reason_not_duplicate_frozen_macro: Includes liquidity and breadth; not the same six-feature macro vote gate.

hypothesis: Best opportunities occur after severe drawdowns when recovery and liquidity appear.
economic_rationale: Crypto rebounds can be convex after forced selling if liquidity and breadth recover.
required_features: market_drawdown, recovery_from_drawdown, distance_from_90d_lows, breadth_recovery, stablecoin_supply_percentile, tvl_acceleration
exact_formula_or_model_specification: Enter BTC/ETH after severe drawdown plus recovery/liquidity score.
risk_controls: cash until capitulation and recovery both appear
expected_failure_mode: Can catch falling knives or miss V-shaped rebounds.
reason_not_duplicate_frozen_macro: Entry requires prior drawdown/recovery, unlike the frozen macro gate.

hypothesis: Upside follows volatility compression when breadth and trend confirm expansion.
economic_rationale: Compression can precede expansion; breadth confirmation reduces false breakouts.
required_features: realized_vol_percentile, volatility_expansion_probability, top_universe_above_30dma_pct, top_universe_30d_high_pct, cross_sectional_dispersion, jump_intensity
exact_formula_or_model_specification: Risk-on when volatility percentile is low and breadth/highs confirm.
risk_controls: cash during high-volatility or weak-breadth states
expected_failure_mode: Breakouts may fail after compression or occur without prior compression.
reason_not_duplicate_frozen_macro: Not a macro vote gate; macro only indirectly used via volatility probability if available.

hypothesis: ETH leadership signals speculative expansion; BTC leadership is more defensive.
economic_rationale: ETH/BTC relative strength can proxy risk appetite inside crypto.
data_availability: available from BTC/ETH OHLCV and macro files
exact_formula_or_model_specification: Choose ETH, BTC, 50/50, or cash from relative strength plus macro stress.
risk_controls: cash when macro/breadth state is poor
expected_failure_mode: ETH/BTC leadership can whipsaw and underperform during deleveraging.
reason_not_full_feature_ml: Single leadership mechanism, not kitchen-sink ML.
reason_not_duplicate_frozen_macro: Chooses BTC versus ETH, not just macro risk-on/off.

hypothesis: Trend-scanning labels identify statistically meaningful trend states better than fixed labels.
economic_rationale: Uses existing trend labels as confirmation, with macro stress as a safety filter.
required_features: trend_t_stat, trend_confidence, trend_upward_label, vix_level, equity_momentum_21d, market_drawdown
data_availability: rejected by Verifier: existing trend-scanning label file is forward-looking
point_in_time_status: not point-in-time safe as live-decision features
exact_formula_or_model_specification: Invest only when lagged trend label is positive and macro stress is not extreme.
risk_controls: cash when trend or macro confirmation is weak
expected_failure_mode: Trend labels may be unstable or too late after trend reversals.
reason_not_full_feature_ml: Uses trend labels plus few controls, not all features.
reason_not_duplicate_frozen_macro: Trend confirmation is structurally different from the frozen macro gate.

hypothesis: Expansion/rebound signals work only when macro stress is not extreme.
economic_rationale: Combines rebound/volatility alpha with a simpler stress filter.
required_features: vix_level, equity_momentum_21d, recovery_from_drawdown, volatility_compression, top_universe_positive_30d_pct, stablecoin_supply_percentile
exact_formula_or_model_specification: Rebound or compression breakout signal must pass a simple VIX/equity stress filter.
risk_controls: cash if macro stress is extreme
expected_failure_mode: Could duplicate risk-off behavior without adding real rebound alpha.
reason_not_duplicate_frozen_macro: Macro filter is simpler and paired with rebound/expansion alpha.

hypothesis: Different simple families may work in different regimes.
economic_rationale: Combines up to three independently rational component signals selected by development CPCV.
data_availability: derived only from deterministic component candidates
point_in_time_status: component candidates selected using development CPCV only
exact_formula_or_model_specification: Equal-weight ensemble of top three non-ensemble components by development CPCV selection score.
risk_controls: no component can exceed 1/3 of ensemble target; no leverage
expected_failure_mode: May average away signal or inherit component overfitting.
reason_not_full_feature_ml: Combines deterministic component rules, not ML over all features.
reason_not_duplicate_frozen_macro: Ensembles non-macro mechanisms; frozen macro gate is benchmark only.
